rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an adaptable person, approach, or way of thinking.

example.english: This person is adaptable and knows how to adjust when situations change.
example.traditional: 呢個人好靈活，遇到新情況都識變通。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jan4 hou2 ling4 wut6 jyu6 dou3 san1 cing4 fong3 dou1 sik1 bin3 tung1

rows.note: Use this especially for flexible rules, schedules, arrangements, or policies.

example.english: This timetable is adaptable, so even last-minute changes are fine.
example.traditional: 呢個時間表幾有彈性，臨時改動都得。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 si4 gaan1 biu2 gei2 jau5 taan4 sing3 lam4 si4 goi2 dung6 dou1 dak1

rows.note: Use this when stressing a person's strong ability to adjust to new circumstances.

example.english: The new colleagues are adaptable and quickly get used to the new job.
example.traditional: 新嚟嗰班同事適應力強，好快就熟習新工作。
example.jyutping: san1 lai4 go2 baan1 tung4 si6 sik1 jing3 lik6 koeng4 hou2 faai3 zau6 suk6 zaap6 san1 gung1 zok3

rows.note: Use this for an object or setting that can be adjusted or modified to suit different conditions.

example.english: The brightness of this lamp is adaptable, so it suits both reading and sleeping.
example.traditional: 呢盞燈嘅光暗可調節，睇書同瞓覺都方便。
example.jyutping: ni1 zaan2 dang1 ge3 gwong1 am3 ho2 tiu4 zit3 tai2 syu1 tung4 fan3 gaau3 dou1 fong1 bin6
